text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell tool in this session, so the fixes come from reading the code and the tests. Please run the suite to confirm.

- **`fees.py`**: the late fee added the daily rate to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, which is what the tests and the policy comment expect.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of the `[-n - 1:]` slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books()` was missing the third book. I added `Emma` by Austen, 1815, 1 copy. The tests only check the title, so the author, year and copy count are my choice.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` kept the year as a string. It now converts it to an `int`.
- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
